Excellent newly refurbished apartment in the village of Hella with a fully equipped kitchen, 75" smart tv and wi-fi. The apartment is located in the old bank building with great views over the river, right next to the local stores, restaurants, services and swimming pool. Hella is an ideal base for exploring south Iceland's famous attractions such as the Golden Circle, Thingvellir National park, main waterfalls, black sand beaches, etc. all within one hour driving distance

We were a group of 8 staying at Harpa's just for one night but it was a great stopover. Finding the apartment was easy, parking out front, and gaining access was straightforward as it was well described ahead of time. The communal spaces were wonderful for our group, having 2 toilets/showers was very useful too. The beds were all super comfortable (my best sleep during our week away). We were staying the night on our way to Vik and explored local waterfalls but didn't really spend too long in Hella itself (though it is beautiful and there are things to do). 4 of us went to the Italian restaurant opposite the apartment and enjoyed a good meal (and fab tiramisu!).
